prompt: tell me a good itenarary for spending a day in london, I want to have the best views this time of the year and also have the best food available
response: Start your day with a visit to the London Eye for panoramic views of the city. Then, head to the Shard for more breathtaking vistas. For lunch, enjoy a traditional English pub meal. In the evening, visit Buckingham Palace to watch the Changing of the Guard.
